Name: Pomodoro
Author: Malika Codes
Description: A Pomodoro timer on a key, one key per task, and a heat map of my focus time on a dial.

Actions.Name: Timer
Actions.Tooltip: Tap to start, pause or carry on. Hold to finish. Tap twice to jump to the break.

Actions.Name: Heat Map
Actions.Tooltip: My focus time, one square a day. Turn to flip between all tasks and each one. Tap to go back to all. Press to jump to the break.

Actions.Name: Sessions
Actions.Tooltip: How many focus sessions I've finished, for one task or all of them. Press to step through today, this week, this year and all time.

Actions.Name: Daily Goal
Actions.Tooltip: A ring that fills up as today's focus sessions get closer to my goal, with a celebration when I get there. Press to play it again.
